articles.availability_note: Source review: MIT’s November23 report and the November10 CC BY4.0 paper describe simulator-based optimization of amplifier sizes within given topologies. Four-turn and eight-turn comparisons differ; commercial-process transfer still loses performance. Local inference differs from GPU training. No independent reproduction, fabricated-chip demonstration or measured business savings is claimed.
